name: Strange noises at night
description: Neighbours report a chair dragging and footsteps in 302 at 3 a.m. — long after the tenant was last seen.

name: Water that won't stop
description: The tap in 302 runs on its own. The meter shows water used every night for nine nights. No one has been inside.

name: The name on the mail
description: Unopened envelopes in the laundry basket are addressed to the tenant by full name — the true name the echo will still answer to.
